notifications.profileLabel: Notify me about events I've joined
notifications.joinWaitlistBody:
The event is full. You'll be queued in order.

If a seat opens, you'll be moved in automatically. The host may also open another convoy when every convoy is full.

We'll send you a Discord DM when you get a seat.
notifications.editNotifyBody: Saving will send Discord DMs about changes to the date/time, tracks, and/or car rules. Waitlisted racers are notified only when the date or time changes.
notifications.dmSetupBody: FORZA.EVENTS can only message you from a Discord server you share.
notifications.joinSupportServerHint: Official support server. Anyone can join — then return here.
notifications.addBotHint: If you manage a Discord server.
notifications.newEventsBrowseLead: Get Discord DMs when new events go live.
notifications.newEventsBrowseEnabledHint: You'll get Discord DMs from the bot. Turn this off in Profile.

addGroup.title: Add convoy {{n}}
addGroup.description: Pick a convoy leader for the new convoy. Racers from the waitlist, other convoys (not convoy leaders), or the host (if not already a convoy leader) can be chosen. Anyone on the waitlist is moved into the new convoy; vacated seats are backfilled from the waitlist.
addGroup.pickLeader: Pick a convoy leader for the new convoy.
addGroup.gamertagRequired: This leader needs an Xbox gamertag.

changeGroupLeader.title: Change convoy leader
changeGroupLeader.description: Pick from the list or search your server. This convoy and the new leader get a Discord DM.
changeGroupLeader.gamertagRequired: This leader needs an Xbox gamertag.
changeGroupLeader.guildSearchDisabled: Convoy is full — pick a driver from the list.

groupRoster.introUneven: Drivers are spread unevenly across convoys. Convoy leaders stay put.
groupRoster.introBalance: Move drivers from fuller convoys into lighter ones until every convoy has the same count.
groupRoster.introBalanceShuffle: Even out convoy sizes, then randomly mix drivers.
groupRoster.introShuffle: Randomly mix drivers between convoys. Each convoy keeps the same headcount.
groupRoster.notifyWarning: Moved racers will receive a Discord DM.
groupRoster.unchanged: No moves needed for this action.
groupRoster.shuffleUnchanged: No seating change found. Try again.
groupRoster.unavailableTip: No moves available. Need at least two drivers who are not convoy leaders.
groupRoster.balanceHint: Move drivers from fuller convoys to lighter ones until counts match.
groupRoster.balanceShuffleHint: Even out convoys, then randomly mix drivers.
groupRoster.shuffleHint: Randomly reassign drivers across convoys. Same count in each convoy.
